mostWorthwhile.text: Testing the backup was most worthwhile: recovering the map correction demonstrated something concrete without claiming to settle whether a restored voice has the same experience.

leastWorthwhile.text: Attaching the cartridge to the cradle was initially confusing; its purpose became clear only in the result.

surprise.text: Moth's question about whether the copy was itself gave a routine backup an unexpectedly personal dimension.

arbitrary.text: The cartridge-and-cradle pairing initially felt arbitrary, although the read-only recovery port explained it afterward.

continue.text: Yes. I'd be curious to see how Moth and the neighborhood develop, though the single available combination at each step made this chapter's gameplay predictable.
